stem.text: An object is dropped at time $t = 0$ from a high building. Air resistance is significant.
Three graphs are plotted against time.
the height of the object above the ground
the magnitude of the resultant force on the object

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis X and horizontal axis time, showing a curve that starts level, falls and then levels off near the time axis.
stem.label: X

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis Y and horizontal axis time, showing a curve that starts level and then falls.
stem.label: Y

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis Z and horizontal axis time, showing a curve that rises and then levels off.
stem.label: Z

stem.text: What are the quantities X, Y and Z?
